name: SONYC-UST: SONYC Urban Sound Tagging Benchmark
description: SONYC Urban Sound Tagging (SONYC-UST) is a multi-label acoustic monitoring benchmark gathered from an urban acoustic sensor network of over 60 physical nodes deployed across New York City. SONYC-UST v2.3 comprises 18,510 10-second audio recordings (13,538 train, 4,308 validation, 664 test) captured with identical microphones. Audio is tagged with a two-level hierarchical taxonomy developed with the NYC Department of Environmental Protection, encompassing 8 coarse classes and 23 fine-grained urban noise categories (including engine, machinery-impact, alert-signal, human-voice, music, dog, powered-saw). Annotated by Zooniverse volunteers and verified by expert acoustic engineers, with spatiotemporal metadata.
